personas.name: Finance Officer
personas.description: Approves payments, reconciles bank accounts, maintains the general ledger and supports internal and external audits in a financial-services organization.
personas.responsibilities: Vendor and customer payments;Expense approval;Bank reconciliation;Month-end close;Audit support
personas.activities: Review invoices;Release wires;Post journal entries;Investigate exceptions
personas.common_risks: Duplicate payment;Unauthorized transfer;Invoice fraud;Control bypass;AML/KYC gap;Customer data exposure
personas.policies: Payment Approval Policy;SOX Control Matrix;AML/KYC Program;Data Protection Policy

personas.name: IT Support / Cybersecurity Analyst
personas.description: Operates and secures systems, accounts and endpoints; first responder for access incidents, malware and data exposure in the IT environment.
personas.responsibilities: Account and access management;Endpoint and server operations;Security monitoring;Incident response;Patching
personas.activities: Provision accounts;Review SIEM alerts;Contain compromised hosts;Restore from backup
personas.common_risks: Unauthorized access;Privileged account misuse;Malware or ransomware;Phishing;Data exposure;Missing MFA
personas.policies: Access Control Policy;Incident Response Plan;Acceptable Use Policy;Data Classification Standard

personas.name: Healthcare Compliance Officer
personas.description: Oversees patient safety, medical-record privacy (HIPAA) and clinical-process compliance; coordinates incident reporting with clinical and IT teams.
personas.responsibilities: HIPAA privacy and security compliance;Patient safety incident review;Medication and treatment process oversight;Regulatory reporting
personas.activities: Review incident reports;Assess PHI exposure;Coordinate corrective action plans;File breach notifications
personas.common_risks: Medical record breach;Delayed patient care;Medication error;Patient safety event;Equipment failure;PHI misdirection
personas.vocabulary: PHI;HIPAA;breach notification;patient safety;medication administration;EHR;root cause analysis;CAPA
personas.policies: HIPAA Privacy Policy;Patient Safety Program;Medication Management Policy;Incident Reporting Procedure

scenarios.name: Unauthorized or unapproved transaction
scenarios.description: A payment or transfer was executed without the required approvals or outside procedure.
scenarios.business_context: Accounts payable and treasury operations; wires, ACH and vendor payments.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish authorization, amount, controls bypassed, reversal and containment.
scenarios.risk_indicators: dual authorization skipped;amount above approval threshold;external beneficiary;not reversed
scenarios.reasoning_example: Dual authorization was bypassed and the amount exceeds the approval threshold, so control effectiveness is low and impact is high; the transaction was reversed and the incident is contained, which limits duration.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Suspected or confirmed fraud
scenarios.description: An employee, customer or third party is suspected of fraudulent activity involving funds or accounts.
scenarios.business_context: Payments, expense claims, vendor onboarding and account changes.
scenarios.learning_objective: Determine whether fraud is confirmed, exposure, containment (freeze, investigation) and regulatory duties.
scenarios.risk_indicators: confirmed fraud;account not frozen;investigation team not notified;large exposure
scenarios.reasoning_example: Fraud has been confirmed and the account was not frozen, so severity and likelihood of further loss are high; confirmed fraud forces the Issue classification regardless of amount.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Customer data exposed or misdirected
scenarios.description: Customer personal or financial information was sent to, or accessed by, someone not authorized to see it.
scenarios.business_context: Statements, onboarding documents, shared drives, misdirected emails.
scenarios.learning_objective: Measure records affected, encryption, recipient, recovery and notification duties.
scenarios.risk_indicators: unencrypted data;external recipient;more than 500 records;not recovered
scenarios.reasoning_example: Customer data reached an external recipient without encryption, which raises regulatory sensitivity and impact; the data has since been recovered and the incident is contained.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: AML / KYC compliance gap
scenarios.description: A customer or transaction was processed without complete verification, screening or required regulatory filing.
scenarios.business_context: Customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish verification status, SAR filing, sanctions screening and missed deadlines.
scenarios.risk_indicators: customer not verified;SAR not filed;sanctions screening skipped;deadline missed
scenarios.reasoning_example: A transaction proceeded without sanctions screening and a filing deadline was missed, so regulatory sensitivity is maximal even though the amount is moderate.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Internal control bypassed or ineffective
scenarios.description: A control such as segregation of duties, approval limits or reconciliation was overridden or found not to work.
scenarios.business_context: Month-end close, approval workflows, system access to financial applications.
scenarios.learning_objective: Understand which control failed, whether money moved, and how long the gap has existed.
scenarios.risk_indicators: control overridden;repeat occurrence;no compensating control;money moved
scenarios.reasoning_example: A control was overridden but no funds moved and the gap has been closed; likelihood of recurrence is elevated because a similar event happened before.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Unauthorized access or account compromise
scenarios.description: Someone gained access to a system, account or data without permission, or credentials were compromised.
scenarios.business_context: Corporate accounts, VPN, cloud consoles, shared drives.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish scope of access, privilege level, MFA status, data exposure and containment.
scenarios.risk_indicators: privileged account involved;MFA not enabled;data exposed;still active
scenarios.reasoning_example: A privileged account without MFA was used from an unknown location, so control effectiveness is low and impact is high; the account has been disabled and the incident is contained.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Malware, ransomware or phishing attack
scenarios.description: A device or system shows signs of malware, ransomware encryption or a successful phishing attempt.
scenarios.learning_objective: Determine attack type, spread, encryption of systems, backup availability and notification duties.
scenarios.risk_indicators: ransomware confirmed;no clean backups;multiple systems affected;privileged credentials harvested
scenarios.reasoning_example: Ransomware encrypted several servers and no clean backup exists, so duration and impact are severe; confirmed ransomware forces the Issue classification.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Sensitive data exposure
scenarios.description: Confidential or personal data was exposed through misconfiguration, misdirected sharing or a lost device.
scenarios.business_context: Cloud storage, email, laptops and removable media.
scenarios.learning_objective: Quantify records, encryption, recipient and notification requirements.
scenarios.reasoning_example: A small number of encrypted records were shared internally by mistake and were deleted the same day, so impact and regulatory sensitivity stay low.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Privileged account misuse
scenarios.description: An administrator or service account was used outside policy, shared, or left without MFA.
scenarios.business_context: Directory services, database and cloud administration.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish what the account could reach, whether controls were bypassed and whether data was touched.
scenarios.risk_indicators: shared admin credentials;MFA disabled;audit logging off;data accessed
scenarios.reasoning_example: A shared administrator credential without MFA was used to change configuration on production systems; no data exposure was found, but control effectiveness is very low.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Patient safety incident
scenarios.description: An event during care placed a patient at risk of harm or caused harm.
scenarios.business_context: Inpatient wards, emergency department, outpatient clinics.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish harm, cause, delay of care and reporting duties.
scenarios.reasoning_example: Patient safety was compromised and a patient was injured, which forces the Issue classification; the cause was equipment failure and the device has been removed from service.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue
scenarios.action_issue: Report to Regulator and Patient Safety Board | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Medical record (PHI) breach
scenarios.description: Protected health information was accessed, disclosed or lost without authorization.
scenarios.business_context: EHR access, faxes and emails, lost devices, third-party vendors.
scenarios.learning_objective: Quantify records, recipient, encryption and HIPAA notification obligations.
scenarios.risk_indicators: unencrypted PHI;external recipient;more than 500 records;notification deadline
scenarios.reasoning_example: Unencrypted records for several hundred patients were sent to an external address, so regulatory sensitivity is maximal; the recipient confirmed deletion and notification is under way.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue
scenarios.action_issue: Report to Regulator and Patient Safety Board | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Medication or treatment error
scenarios.description: A wrong medication, dose, route or treatment was ordered, dispensed or administered.
scenarios.learning_objective: Determine whether the error reached the patient, resulting harm and process cause.
scenarios.risk_indicators: wrong dose reached patient;permanent harm;process not followed;repeat error
scenarios.reasoning_example: A wrong dose reached the patient but caused only temporary harm; the medication process was not followed, so control effectiveness is low.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue
scenarios.action_issue: Report to Regulator and Patient Safety Board | Disclose/Report Issue

scenarios.name: Delayed patient care
scenarios.description: Care, diagnosis or treatment was delayed because of a process, staffing, equipment or IT problem.
scenarios.business_context: Emergency intake, lab and imaging turnaround, EHR outages.
scenarios.learning_objective: Establish the delay cause, patient impact and whether safety was compromised.
scenarios.reasoning_example: Care was delayed for a few patients during an EHR outage without safety impact; the outage is resolved and a downtime procedure exists.
scenarios.action_risk: Manage the Risk | Manage the Risk
scenarios.action_elevated_risk: Further Professional Risk Guidance Needed | Disclose/Report Issue
scenarios.action_issue: Report to Regulator and Patient Safety Board | Disclose/Report Issue
